messages:
Priya S.: FYI customer hitting intermittent 400s with Go SDK when using JSON mode streaming. They can repro locally.
Priya S.: Error from our API: "invalid_json: unexpected token". Happens when payload contains a NUL (0x00) in a string and the chunk boundary splits right after it.
Alex M.: can you paste minimal repro and sdk version?
Priya S.: Go SDK 0.8.6, streaming JSONMode enabled. Repro steps: 1) open stream, 2) send object with a string that includes "\u0000" in the middle, 3) force a small write buffer so chunk split is between bytes. Attached log: 
```
recv chunk: "{\"id\":1,\"text\":\"hello\u0000world\"}\n..."
parser error: malformed JSON at offset 27
```
Priya S.: Customer says switching to NDJSON works, but they need JSON mode for structured outputs.
Alex M.: :eyes: this sounds like our streaming parser treats 0x00 as a delimiter/terminator in the dechunker. Could be a serde/buffer trimming bug.
Jordan K.: Agree. In the runtime we unescape sequences then feed to decoder. If a chunk boundary slices a multi-byte escape or a NUL literal it can confuse state machine.
Marcus R.: Marcus R. (oncall): Escalating to eng runtime/serializers if we have a consistent repro. Can you add a tiny repro that reproduces in ~1s? I'll create an internal ticket.
Priya S.: Pasted a minimal Go program from the customer inline: 
```
// minimal: open a net.Conn to our endpoint, write small frames with the JSON containing "\u0000" split across writes
conn.Write([]byte("{\"id\":1,\"text\":\"hello\""))
conn.Write([]byte("\u0000world\"}\n"))
```
Alex M.: I can repro locally with that pattern. Workaround: turn off streaming (use single-shot) or use NDJSON. Also increasing client write buffer so the NUL doesn't fall at boundary seems to avoid it.
Jordan K.: I'll file bug and propose fix: ensure dechunker treats NUL as data byte (not delimiter) and preserve escape state across chunks. If it's a Go stdlib decoder edge, add streaming wrapper to hold incomplete escape sequences.
SupportBot: Escalation created: TICKET-3642 assigned to eng-runtime. :ticket: https://internal/issues/TICKET-3642
Priya S.: Customer confirmed workaround (NDJSON) acceptable as temporary. They asked ETA.
Marcus R.: Jordan, can you mark priority P1 (customer in prod) and try a patch/PR today?
Jordan K.: Marked P1. I'll attempt small patch to dechunker and add unit test reproducing split-escape + NUL. If successful will target hotfix branch. :bug:
Alex M.: After patch we should add a short integration test in the Go SDK streaming tests to cover explicit split points.
Priya S.: Thanks all — I'll update customer with workaround and ETA once we have PR.
Alex M.: thx :thumbsup:
Jordan K.: will ping in-thread once PR is up.
Marcus R.: closing loop after deploy verification.
